items.title: Wendy Oxenhorn — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Bette Midler I think was playing there. They were already famous, I think, and they were making these club appearances.

ctx.x: ...you were involved in dance at an early age.

My parents were very cool about that. They knew that all I wanted to do was dance. It was truly the love of my life. In order to do it, you couldn’t keep commuting. My mother was driving me in constantly, and that was hard on her, it was hard on my little brother. They had no other life. And what happens, when you get to a certain age in dance, you have to commit and you have to be here. So I had to go to a special school for the arts. I had to make my way here. So I lived with another family, and I started that…
